top_signals.title: EU General Clancy on Russian Threat, EU Defense Spending
top_signals.summary: EU Military Committee Chairman Seán Clancy says hybrid activity is now the most serious threat to the European Union and increased EU defense spending is strengthening US relations. Clancy spoke to Bloomberg's Oliver Crook in Brussels.  (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Investors Watching Every Data Point: Haefele
top_signals.summary:
Mark Haefele, UBS Global Wealth Management CIO, joins Bloomberg's Vonnie Quinn on "Bloomberg Brief" to discuss the investor appetite in various Fed policy scenarios.
 (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: U.S. Diesel Prices Hit All-Time High as Global Fuel Squeeze Deepens
top_signals.summary: The average U.S. diesel price hit a record high late on Thursday, exceeding the previous record from 2022, as the Middle East crisis tightened global fuel markets and sent prices soaring this summer. As of Thursday afternoon, the live U.S. national average price of diesel set a new record at $5.820 per gallon, according to GasBuddy data.   This average price has now surpassed the previous daily $5.819 per gallon all-time high that occurred June 17, 2022, Patrick De Haan, head of petroleum analysis at GasBuddy, said. top_signals.title: South Korean regulators introduce tokenized securities roadmap
top_signals.summary: South Korea’s financial regulator introduced a three-phase roadmap for the issuance of tokenized assets, as the country prepares to adopt its first tokenized securities framework in February 2027.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
